I found three ticket numbers on Marrow Fieldworks and replied to you in our DM.

1. #4409, from Moss's "Central handoffs next week" note (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it before the account changed hands on 5 Jan.
2. #4412, from the same Moss note. It's a small glitch in the driver text prompts when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots.
3. PD-5302, from Hollis in #central-random on 14 Oct. He said it's for a follow-up from this week.

One possible extra: #8841, from Tobias in #central-random on 13 Oct, about West yard Door 2 double-booking. That thread only calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. The Moss note calls Marrow Fieldworks your dealer account, so they may not be the same account. I listed it as unconfirmed and suggested you check with Tobias.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. None of Moss's other notes mention Marrow Fieldworks. Apart from #central-random, none of the channels you're in have any messages this week.
